lines: A friend always “forgets” to return calls after you share your feelings.
You keep waiting, hoping the next conversation will be different.
Each silence feels like a personal rejection.
People avoid discomfort by disappearing, not confronting.
Your value isn’t measured by who remembers you.
Choose people who show up, not those who vanish.
Follow for more daily life changing videos.
cta: Follow for more daily life changing videos.
caption: Don’t chase ghosts. Save for when you need a reminder.
